drag_coefficient_sphere — DRIVE ball op

• 資料種類:signal → signal

• 呼叫: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.drag_coefficient_sphere(reynolds) -> 'np.ndarray'(要直接呼叫實作,import ballistics; ballistics.drag_coefficient_sphere(reynolds) -> 'np.ndarray';從台帳取用則 opsdrive.get("drag_coefficient_sphere"))

用法

> 該運算子的說明尚無譯文,以下照原文給出。

滑らかな球の抗力係数の経験式(Morrison 2013、Re ≲ 1e6): 24/Re + 2.6(Re/5)/(1 + (Re/5)^1.52) + 0.411(Re/263000)^−7.94/(1 + (Re/263000)^−8)

+ 0.25(Re/1e6)/(1 + Re/1e6)。卓球の球(Re ≈ 1〜5 × 10⁴)で ≈ 0.4〜0.5。
